exposure.needed: whether users connect Helm repositories through the UI connect page using a bearer token

consequence.statement: Users connecting a Helm repository with a bearer token through the Argo CD UI connect page encounter different (fixed) validation behavior than in the previous release; the changelog does not state the prior misbehavior or any failing outcome.

assertion.statement: Argo CD v3.0.0 fixes bearer token validation on the UI's Helm connect page, changing that validation behavior relative to earlier releases.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The changelog line names only a UI bugfix ('fix bearerToken validate in helm connect page') and identifies no configuration field, values key, flag, endpoint, image or protocol element that can be pinned to a supported subject family.
